title: Leveraging Multidisciplinary Team Strengths
audience: Clinical learners planning multidisciplinary teams for clinical AI projects
objectives: Identify essential roles for a real-time stroke triage AI project.
Plan communication across clinical, technical, administrative, and patient-facing roles.
Practice shared decision-making when accuracy and explainability trade off.
Design training, collaboration tools, secure sharing, workflow integration, and ethics processes.

sections.name: Introduction
sections.purpose: Frame the clinical AI teamwork scenario.
sections.how_to_use: Review the stroke triage case and optional sample data previews before choosing assignment sections.

sections.name: The Multidisciplinary Landscape
sections.how_to_use: List five roles, responsibilities, expertise, and project impact.

sections.name: Communication Strategies
sections.purpose: Plan communication for mixed clinical and technical expertise.
sections.how_to_use: Write a communication strategy, shared glossary, and patient/workflow focus plan.

sections.name: Team-Based Decision-Making
sections.how_to_use: Design a decision process, identify cognitive biases, and write a decision documentation template.

sections.name: Training Opportunities
sections.purpose: Close knowledge gaps between clinical and technical members.
sections.how_to_use: Plan cross-training, shadowing, and external resources.

sections.name: Collaboration Tools
sections.purpose: Choose tools and secure sharing protocols.
sections.how_to_use: Pick tools, document their purpose and limitations, and define sharing protocols.

sections.name: Reflection
sections.purpose: Connect teamwork to clinical workflow, adoption, effectiveness, and ethics.
sections.how_to_use: Reflect on integration challenges, success metrics, and ethical issue resolution.

chatbot_guidance: When asked how to use this notebook, tell the learner to start with the introduction and use the section selector.
For clinical users, emphasize workflow fit, patient safety, accountability, explainability, secure data sharing, and stakeholder alignment.
Help learners write concrete role responsibilities and communication plans.
